- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md enumerates all four branches
  Verify: for b in hard_delete trash_restore project_move out_of_window; do grep -q \"$b\" .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md notes stdlib-urllib choice (no requests dep)

  Verify: grep -F '60c3-a905-755c-46be' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## Implementation Notes
Append a subsection to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md covering:
1. Read-only probe contract — REST GET only; tested via Request.get_method() == 'GET' invariant.
2. Four-branch classifier:
   - hard_delete (HTTP 404) → inbound delete of local jira-* ticket
   - trash_restore (HTTP 410) → no-op + audit log (Jira may auto-restore)
   - project_move (HTTP 200, project.key != DIG) → reparent local ticket with new project
   - out_of_window (HTTP 200, in DIG, updated < window) → no-op + audit log (issue still exists but outside fetcher window)
3. Stdlib-urllib choice — no `requests` dep was added. Operators won't see a new package on pip list.
4. Reference story id 60c3-a905-755c-46be.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
